info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Status API enables developers to retrieve the current statuses of fitness memberships within the system. This endpoint provides essential information about member subscriptions, allowing for informed management and engagement strategies. Typical consumers of this API include gym operators and fitness platform administrators who need to monitor and analyze membership health and activity. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance member retention and streamline operational insights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of a user's membership. It provides essential information regarding the validity and type of the membership, along with any additional details relevant to the user's access and benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve the current status of memberships. Ensure that you follow the schema provided to send a valid request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of memberships.

ListFitnessMembershipsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of memberships. The value is expected to be a string.
